## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/).
- [ ] I ran the checks for the parts I changed (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/homlo-bike/MobSimLab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] New or changed public functions have a doc comment with purpose, inputs, outputs and side effects.
- [ ] A change to an architecture decision has a new or updated ADR in `docs/adr/`.
- [ ] Values used in calculations have a source or an assumption record with a range.
- [ ] New dependencies pass the licence gate (`tools/license-gate`).
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data are committed.
